title: The three-point seed attains the sharp controlled all-seed cubic envelope after rectangular-shape optimization

inputs.seed_family: S(B,u_0,u_1) from K1703, with B>=p_*^(-1/2) and 0<u_0<=u_*<=u_1<=2 so X_* is included.
inputs.shape_space: The compactified centered axis-aligned K1683 rectangles from K1697.
inputs.shape_data: M=max_C R_0(C) and S_*=min_(C in argmax R_0)S_0(C)>0.

envelope.matching_upper: Choosing the K1702 seed X_* gives H_S(g)<=-6g^2M+108g^3S_*+o(g^3).
envelope.comparison: The controlled all-seed cubic envelope is below the Rademacher envelope by (576/5)S_*g^3+o(g^3).

scope_guard: All-seed means the controlled family S(B,u_0,u_1), not every bounded seed with coupling-dependent support or vanishing defect. The result remains a scalar-product rectangular trial upper envelope, not an unrestricted lower bound or true coefficient.
